sources.title: Model-based digital pianos: from physics to sound synthesis
The simulation of piano string vibration: From physical models to finite difference schemes and digital waveguides

provenance.notes: Hand-tuned defaults based on the reduced real-time models in the cited papers. Version 2 stores the former keyboard-wide string and hammer curves as direct values for all 88 keys. The key-to-body-mode matrix is a smooth modeled bridge projection, not a measured soundboard fit.
